## Architecture Overview

The `AddKnownTypes` method on `runtime.Scheme` accepts a `schema.GroupVersion` and variadic `runtime.Object` arguments. Every project that registers custom CRD types calls `scheme.AddKnownTypes(GroupVersion, &Type1{}, &Type2{}, ...)`. Changing to a `TypeRegistration` struct breaks all these registration patterns.

## Detailed Analysis

### Cert-Manager

- **`pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/register.go`** (line 50) — `scheme.AddKnownTypes(SchemeGroupVersion, &Certificate{}, &CertificateList{}, &Issuer{}, ...)` registers all cert-manager types.
- **`pkg/apis/acme/v1/register.go`** (line 50) — `scheme.AddKnownTypes(SchemeGroupVersion, &Order{}, &OrderList{}, &Challenge{}, &ChallengeList{})`.
- **`internal/apis/certmanager/register.go`** (line 41) — Internal API registration.
- **`pkg/apis/config/controller/v1alpha1/register.go`** (line 50) — Controller config registration.
- **`internal/apis/acme/register.go`** — Internal ACME API registration.
- **`internal/apis/config/controller/register.go`** — Internal config registration.

### External-Secrets

- **`apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go`** — Uses `scheme.Builder.Register()` pattern (lines 76-79) which internally calls `AddKnownTypes`.
- **`apis/externalsecrets/v1beta1/register.go`** — Same Register() pattern.
- **`apis/externalsecrets/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Same pattern.
- **`apis/generators/v1alpha1/register.go`** — Generator types registration.

### Grafana

- **`pkg/apis/iam/v0alpha1/register.go`** (lines 56-65) — Custom `AddKnownTypes()` helper calling `scheme.AddKnownTypes()` with variadic types.
- **`pkg/apis/service/v0alpha1/register.go`** (line 59) — `scheme.AddKnownTypes(SchemeGroupVersion, &ExternalName{}, &ExternalNameList{})`.
- **`apps/scope/pkg/apis/scope/v0alpha1/register.go`** (lines 147-163) — Custom `AddKnownTypes()` with variadic registration.
- **`apps/secret/pkg/apis/secret/v1beta1/register.go`** (lines 63-72) — SecureValue/Keeper types.
- **`apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/provisioning/v0alpha1/register.go`** (lines 182-198) — Repository/Job types.

### OpenTelemetry Operator

- **`cmd/operator-opamp-bridge/internal/config/config.go`** (lines 43-51) — `s.AddKnownTypes(v1alpha1.GroupVersion, &v1alpha1.OpenTelemetryCollector{}, ...)`.
- **`apis/v1beta1/metrics_test.go`** (lines 127, 202) — Test usage of `AddKnownTypes`.

| cert-manager | pkg/apis/certmanager/v1/register.go | Variadic AddKnownTypes for Certificate, Issuer types |
| cert-manager | pkg/apis/acme/v1/register.go | Variadic AddKnownTypes for Order, Challenge types |
| cert-manager | internal/apis/certmanager/register.go | Internal API registration |
| cert-manager | pkg/apis/config/controller/v1alpha1/register.go | Controller config registration |
| external-secrets | apis/externalsecrets/v1/register.go | SchemeBuilder.Register() calling AddKnownTypes |
| external-secrets | apis/externalsecrets/v1beta1/register.go | V1beta1 type registration |
| external-secrets | apis/externalsecrets/v1alpha1/register.go | V1alpha1 type registration |
| grafana | pkg/apis/iam/v0alpha1/register.go | Custom AddKnownTypes helper |
| grafana | pkg/apis/service/v0alpha1/register.go | Service type registration |
| grafana | apps/scope/pkg/apis/scope/v0alpha1/register.go | Scope type registration |
| grafana | apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/provisioning/v0alpha1/register.go | Provisioning type registration |
| opentelemetry-operator | cmd/operator-opamp-bridge/internal/config/config.go | OTel Collector type registration |
